title: SemantEq: Faithful Bidirectional Equivalence of Formal Statements
abstract: arXiv:2610.32919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Statement autoformalization translates mathematics from natural language into a proof assistant such as Lean 4, and models now do it at scale. As provers get stronger, the burden of correctness shifts from the proof to the statement, that is, to whether the formal statement faithfully translates its source. Given a trusted reference formalization, the natural test is logical equivalence, and it proves too much. $P \leftrightarrow Q$ holds trivially for any two statements $P$ and $Q$ that the library proves, because a prover can prove each separately and pass through $P \leftrightarrow \mathrm{True} \leftrightarrow Q$. The stronger the prover, the more unrelated pairs pass. Earlier methods restrict the prover and check that each proof names the other statement. We introduce SemantEq, a more principled relation that instead requires each statement to turn into the other only through a chain of allowed steps, such as logical rearrangement a

translated_title: SemantEq：形式化命题的忠实双向等价
translated_abstract: 命题自动形式化是将数学从自然语言翻译成 Lean 4 等证明助手语言的过程，如今模型已经可以大规模地完成这一任务。随着证明器变得越来越强，正确性的负担从证明转移到了命题本身，即形式化命题是否忠实地翻译了其源文本。给定一个可信的参考形式化，最自然的检验标准是逻辑等价，但逻辑等价证明的内容过多：对于库中已证明的任意两个命题 P 和 Q，P ↔ Q 都会平凡地成立，因为证明器可以分别证明 P 和 Q，并通过 P ↔ True ↔ Q 完成推导。证明器越强，通过检验的无关命题对就越多。早期的方法通过限制证明器的能力，并检查每个证明是否引用了另一个命题。我们提出 SemantEq，一种更有原则的等价关系，它要求每个命题只能通过一系列允许的步骤（如逻辑重排等）转化为另一个命题……
tldr: 提出 SemantEq，一种更有原则的形式化命题等价检验方法，要求命题间只能通过一系列允许的逻辑变换步骤相互转化，从而避免因证明器过强导致逻辑等价检验被平凡通过的问题。
en_tdlr: We introduce SemantEq, a more principled equivalence relation for formal statements that requires each statement to transform into the other only through chains of allowed steps, avoiding the trivial passes of logical equivalence caused by increasingly strong provers.
